title: Arrival and layout
observed: Dirty vehicle and customer in a marked parking area. The wash operates in a sunny outdoor lot, with a small service building and street beyond.

title: Sponge / local foam
observed: A hand and sponge work directly over the car surface. Bubble clusters cover the rear glass and roof. HUD shows 21.1% foaming, 11% cleaned total, and a 64% cleaning goal.

title: Foam coverage / next step
observed: The front is covered in thick foam; the checklist has advanced to washing and offers the next step. This frame is still the sponge tool, not the rinse tool.

title: High view of roof
observed: Elevated viewpoint exposes the roof. HUD offers Elevate, wet sponge, switch tool, switch soap color and X-ray vision. Nearly complete foaming corresponds to only 50% cleaned total.

title: Hose / local removal
observed: Hand-held hose sprays near the rear wheel and body. Blue paint is exposed while foam remains on adjacent surfaces. Total cleaned is 91%, above the 64% goal, and finishing is available.

title: Customer feedback
observed: Customer panel displays high mood. Job panel shows standard wash $300, 100% work, 64% goal, extra-clean bonus indicator and total $555. Do not infer the arithmetic from this single frame.

title: Suspicious-customer tutorial
observed: Tutorial directs the player to acquire a baseball bat. Behind it are a suspicious-customer warning and a thief-risk meter.

title: Risk and acceptance
observed: Customer emits a greenish haze. Panel has a thief meter with safe/risky/danger zones and accept/kick choices. This filename was captured after the tutorial closed.

title: Bat confrontation
observed: Bat is held in view and the suspicious customer is lying on the ground. The objective still asks for the customer car to be washed; this is before the later payment/escape event.

title: Payment triggers thief objective
observed: After the key-handover choice, washing and payment-attempt checklist items are checked. The remaining objective is to take down the thief.

title: Unresolved pursuit
observed: Player looks toward soap-storage equipment with the thief objective active. Captions express that they have no vehicle. This frame establishes the objective, not a successful chase or police call.
